disclaimer: Screening aid, not a diagnosis. Possible signs only; not clinically validated.

input_spec.name: image
input_spec.preprocessing: common/preprocess.py preprocess_image (standard mode), then HWC to CHW. No ImageNet mean/std normalization.

output_spec.name: probability
output_spec.meaning: Probability of the Parkinson's class, sigmoid already applied.

threshold_selection: Highest specificity on a grouped validation split at a target sensitivity of 0.9. Chosen on validation only.

training_data.sources: HandPD and NewHandPD (UNESP), spiral and meander (wave) drawings
training_data.refit: Final model refit on all available images; cross-validation estimates come from separate fold models.

cv_metrics.note: No real cross-validation run has been recorded for this model yet.

int8.note: AUC change is measured on a small sample and only compares the two exports against each other.

known_limits: Trained on scanned paper drawings (HandPD and NewHandPD); live canvas drawings are a different domain, and predictions on them are not validated against clinical labels.
Small dataset (158 subjects across both sources): metrics have wide confidence intervals and many model comparisons are within noise.
Class imbalance: Parkinson's subjects outnumber healthy subjects in the training data.
The decision threshold favors sensitivity on a validation split, so expect false positives.
Not a diagnostic tool. It must not be used to rule a condition in or out.
warning: Development model: trained for one epoch on a tiny sample with random initialization to prove the pipeline runs. Not a real screening model.
